title: Metagenome Preparations and Analysis
author: Bryan Yoo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bzqep5te
materials: DNA was extracted with the Qiagen MagAttract PowerSoil DNA kit as previously described (Marotz et al 2017). Our standard protocol is optimized for an input quantity of 1ng DNA per reaction.
Prior to library preparation, input DNA is transferred to a 384-well plate and quantified using a PicoGreen fluorescence assay (ThermoFisher, Inc).

steps.title: Sample Collection and Treatment
steps.instruction: Deliver AAV-PHP.S:hSYN1-hM3Dq-mRuby2 (10^12 VGs) systemically to TH-Cre and ChAT-Cre mice. After 3-4 weeks, administer C21 (3mg/kg) daily for 10 consecutive days. Collect fecal pellets in sterile containers one day before the first C21 dose and between subsequent doses.

steps.title: DNA Normalization
steps.instruction: Normalize input DNA to 1ng in a volume of 3.5μL of molecular-grade water using an Echo 550 acoustic liquidhandling robot.

steps.title: Fragmentation and End Repair
steps.instruction: Prepare enzyme mixes for fragmentation, end repair, A-tailing, ligation, and PCR, adding them in approximately 1:8 scale volumes using a Mosquito HV micropipetting robot.

substeps.instruction: Perform fragmentation at 37°C for 20min.
Perform end repair and A-tailing at 65°C for 30min.

steps.title: Adapter Ligation and Purification
steps.instruction: Add universal adapter 'stub' molecules and ligase mix to the end-repaired DNA using the Mosquito HV robot and ligate at 20°C for 1h.

substeps.instruction: Remove unligated adapters and dimers using AMPure XP magnetic beads and a BlueCat purification robot.
Add 7.5 μL magnetic bead solution to the total adapter-ligated sample volume.
Wash twice with 70% EtOH.
Resuspend in 7μL molecular-grade water.

steps.title: Indexing
steps.instruction: Add individual i7 and i5 indices to the adapter-ligated samples using the Echo 550 robot, iterating the assignment of i7 to i5 indices each run to prevent contamination and allow pooling.

steps.title: Library Amplification
steps.instruction: Combine 4.5μL of eluted bead-washed ligated samples with 5.5μL of PCR master mix and amplify for 15 cycles.

steps.title: Final Library Purification and Quantitation
steps.instruction: Purify amplified and indexed libraries using magnetic beads and the BlueCat robot.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in 10μL water.
Transfer 9μL of final purified library to a 384-well plate using the Mosquito HV robot for quantitation, sequencing, and storage.
Normalize 384 samples based on a PicoGen fluorescence assay.

steps.title: Bioinformatic Pre-processing
steps.instruction: Process Illumina HiSeq data via Qiita and clean the reads.

substeps.instruction: Remove adapter sequences using Atropos v.1.1.15 (qp-shogun 0.1.5 pipeline).
Filter reads for mouse contamination using Bowtie2 v.2-2.2.3.

steps.title: Taxonomic Alignment and Filtering
steps.instruction: Align filtered reads to the Web of Life (WoL) reference phylogeny using Bowtie2 via an adapted SHOGUN pipeline.

substeps.instruction: Exclude reads that do not map to a single reference genome or map to multiple genomes.
Exclude OTUs with relative abundance less than 0.01% in a given sample.
Exclude OTUs with fewer than 5 assigned reads.

steps.title: Diversity Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze sample diversity using QIIME2 v.2019.7.

substeps.instruction: Rarefy samples to a depth of 12,750 reads; exclude samples below this depth.
Use the DEICODE plugin to calculate Aitchison distances and perform Robust Aitchison PCA.
Use the QIIME2 diversity plugin to calculate alpha- and beta-diversity metrics.

steps.title: Functional Profiling
steps.instruction: Establish functional profiles using HUMAnN2 v2.8.1.

substeps.instruction: Use MetaPhlAn 2 to compile custom reference genome databases based on detected species.
Map filtered reads to custom databases; perform translated search of non-mapping reads against the UniRef90 database.
Combine results and report gene families in read per kilobase (RPKs).
Compare gene families with the MetaCyc pathways database to report pathway abundances.

steps.title: Functional Diversity Analysis
steps.instruction: Calculate alpha- and beta-diversity metrics using QIIME2 diversity and DEICODE plugins after rarefaction.

substeps.instruction: Rarefy gene family tables to a depth of 166,000 RPKs.
Rarefy pathway abundances to a depth of 22,600.
